review.decision: implement bounded failure diagnostics before the one remaining authorized live attempt
review.notes: First authorized real CLI attempt failed without terminal receipt; prior implementation discarded all diagnostics. Add only fixed-vocabulary failure category and numeric exit code, not raw stderr/provider errors/URLs. No credentials, native session reads, model fallback, or permission changes. User prohibits commits; snapshot seal records review before implementation, no PR order claim. Local installed-CLI reproduction with a credential-free loopback fixture confirms item.completed/type=error is a nonterminal Code Mode disabled notice followed by a valid result; previous parser misclassified it as a tool action. Reviewed before adding the warning regression; do not enable tools or ignore fatal terminal errors.

cases.description: CLI failures retain useful classified evidence without private diagnostics
cases.setup: Disposable HOME, fake executable only; no account or network call.
cases.action: Emit a provider authentication error containing a synthetic secret/URL, stderr config failure with nonzero exit, overlong stderr, cancellation, and no terminal receipt. Complete one failed Dream run with malicious arbitrary diagnostic text. Replay a nonterminal item.error notice before a valid terminal result, plus a real command_execution item and fatal turn.failed event.
cases.expected: Only allowlisted category and numeric exit code reach errors/journal; raw diagnostics never appear; bounded capture drains without blocking; failed attempt/time/unknown usage preserved; old journal records remain readable; success stays diagnostic-free. Nonterminal diagnostic items cannot masquerade as tool execution; they neither invalidate a successful terminal receipt nor turn a fatal/missing receipt into success. Actual tool/action items remain rejected.
